response.original_title: What is the range of 4 BHK flats in Ahmedabad?
response.overview: The price of a 4 BHK flat in Ahmedabad can vary based on the location, carpet area, project quality, amenities, builder and surrounding infrastructure. As a general range, buyers may find 4 BHK flats starting from around ₹1 crore and going up to ₹4 crore or more. Premium localities and luxury residential projects can have significantly higher prices. Areas such as SG Highway, Thaltej, Science City, Bodakdev, Satellite, Sindhu Bhavan Road, Shilaj, Bopal and Shela can have different price ranges depending on the type of property and its exact location. Properties in developing areas may offer larger spaces at comparatively different prices. When comparing a 4 BHK flat in Ahmedabad, do not look only at the quoted price. Check the carpet area, floor plan, construction quality, amenities, parking, maintenance charges, location and additional purchase costs such as registration and stamp duty.
